notes.title: Update Announcement on August 2nd
notes.content: Update announcement on August 2nd: Korean and Russian local languages have been updated and optimized, and some contents have been optimized.

notes.title: "DREAD FLATS" Gratitude Letter & Free DLC Roadmap
notes.content:
[h2][b]To all players:[/b]
Thank you for your passion and feedback! We’re fully aware of the game’s imperfections, but every suggestion fuels our progress. Over the next month, we’ll focus on:[/h2][h2][/h2][h2][b]Short-Term Plans (Within 1 Month)[/b]
・Priority fixes for high-frequency bugs and QoL issues based on community reports.
・Enhanced localization for additional languages.[/h2][p][/p][h2][b]Free DLC Preview[/b]
Currently in development:
・[b]Expanded Lore:[/b] Answers to unresolved plot mysteries.
・[b]New Horrors:[/b] More chilling encounters and designs.
・[b]100% Free:[/b] A thank-you gift for your support![/h2][p][/p][h3]We’re endlessly grateful to every player.[/h3]

notes.title: Regarding the unresponsive main menu issue and 2K resolution update.
notes.content:
[olist][*][p]We sincerely apologize that some players using 2K resolution experienced unresponsive main menu buttons upon launch. This issue has been fixed in yesterday's update.[/p][/*][/olist][p]However, we regret to inform affected players that deleting configuration save files may still be required to resolve this problem completely.[/p][p]Solution steps:[/p][olist][*][p]Navigate to:
C:\\Users\\Administrator(your username)\\AppData\\Local\\project_A[/p][/*][*][p]Delete all files in this folder[/p][/*][*][p]Relaunch the game[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.content:
